name: Mario Bautista

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (69 in height, 69 in reach, born 1993-07-01); fight weight = bantamweight limit 135 lb

photo_coverage: Good, but no freely licensed photo: Wikimedia Commons has no photo of him (the Commons file "Mario Bautista (2019).png" shows a different person, a singer, and was checked and rejected). Official studio headshot and two full-body cut-outs, July 2026 UFC 329 media day (three-quarter right), post-fight press conference (frontal, with fresh fight swelling), weigh-in face-off (left-side profile) and double-biceps weigh-in pose, plus a Feb 2026 fight photo.

face.shape: Long, lean face, widest at the cheekbones and tapering to a fairly narrow chin (oval to slightly inverted-triangle). Very little facial fat.
face.jaw: Narrow-to-medium, well-defined; the line from the ear to the chin is sharp and slightly angular.
face.chin: Narrow, slightly pointed and rounded at the tip, moderate projection in profile (UFC 329 face-off).
face.cheekbones: Prominent and fairly high, with hollows below them and long, deep nasolabial creases from the nostrils past the mouth corners; vertical creases on the cheeks (visible at rest in the studio headshot).
face.brow_ridge: Moderate; brows sit low and close over the eyes, giving an intense look.
face.forehead: Medium height, slightly sloping in profile, with horizontal lines at rest.

eyes.shape: Medium almond eyes with a visible upper-lid crease, slightly deep-set, a little under-eye shadowing.
eyes.colour: Dark brown. Closest MakeHuman iris: brown.

eyebrows.shape: Low and fairly straight, slightly heavier at the inner ends and angled a little down toward the nose (outer ends slightly higher), which reads as a focused frown at rest.
eyebrows.colour: Very dark brown to black (patch sample #4d342e includes skin; render near #1f1817)

nose.width: Medium bridge; nostrils and tip medium-wide
nose.bridge: Straight to very slightly convex in profile, moderate projection
nose.fight_damage: No clear deviation; slight flattening of the bridge possible. Fresh cut and swelling under the right eye and on the right brow in the July 2026 post-fight photo are temporary.

face.mouth_lips: Medium width; thin upper lip, medium lower lip; mouth corners turn slightly down at rest, framed by the deep nasolabial creases.

ears.size: Medium-large, protruding noticeably in frontal photos.
ears.cauliflower_ear: Mild: the upper ears look slightly thickened and lumpy in the studio headshot, more on the right ear; not severe.

face.marks_scars: Deep expression lines (forehead, nasolabial, cheek creases) are the main marks; no large scars visible.

hair.style: Dark hair with the sides shaved very high (skin to near skin), longer top. July 2026: top about 5-7 cm swept back into a high crest, the shaved sides go high enough that it reads almost as a mohawk in profile. Feb 2026 and studio: shorter textured top about 4 cm pushed forward/up with a skin fade.
hair.hairline: Fairly straight across with slight temple recession at the corners.

facial_hair.density: Clean-shaven in all photos; light stubble shadow at most.

skin.tone_hex_method: Plain RGB mean of the samples marked in_average (well-lit cheeks and a media-day forehead; the specular studio forehead, a bright highlight and the overexposed post-fight photo excluded); each sample is the mean of the 15th-85th luma-percentile pixels of the patch.
skin.tone_note: Light-medium tan; the torso and limbs read deeper and more bronzed than the face.
skin.freckles_marks: Little chest hair; dark hair on the forearms and legs.

body.build: Lean and muscular bantamweight (175 cm): dense, athletic, slightly more muscular than average for the division.
body.body_fat_note: Abs, obliques and serratus clearly visible in the studio cut-outs and at the July 2026 weigh-in.
body.shoulders: Broad for his frame with round, full deltoids and visible upper trapezius.
body.arms: Muscular with full biceps (double-biceps pose, July 2026) and veiny forearms; reach equals height.
body.legs_calves: Lean, muscular thighs and average calves.
body.posture: Upright with a slightly forward head and level shoulders; arms hang with a slight bend, hands loosely fisted.
body.notable: Strongest cues: long lean face with deep nasolabial creases, low thick dark brows, high-shaved sides with a longer swept-back top, the Death Before Dishonor chest script, and a lean, muscular, tattooed torso.

stance_and_guard.stance: Switch (fighters.json): fights from both orthodox and southpaw.
stance_and_guard.observed: Feb 2026 fight photo (orthodox at that moment): right cross fully extended with the shoulder turned in, left glove pressed tight to the chin and cheek, chin tucked behind the lead shoulder. Studio: weight even, hands loose at the sides.
stance_and_guard.animation_hint: Tight guard with the non-punching glove glued to the chin and the chin down; switches between orthodox and southpaw. Medium-length stance; hands held at chin height rather than low.

tattoos.description: Large black ornate script reading Death Before Dishonor with flourishes underneath.
Black-and-grey ram skull with curled horns and a feather below.

tattoos.where: Right thigh, front, from below the shorts to the knee
tattoos.description: Colour piece in a Mesoamerican style: a jaguar head wearing a feathered headdress (teal, green, orange and red) above a skull, with feathers hanging toward the knee.

tattoos.where: Left upper chest and shoulder near the neck
tattoos.description: Smaller black illustrative and script pieces around the left shoulder/upper pectoral (seen in the Feb 2026 fight photo and the July 2026 post-fight photo); details not readable.

kit.fight_shorts_recent: Blue UFC Venum kit with dark scale/wave pattern and crypto.com (studio, 2024-25); Feb 2026 fight: blue kit with red BAUTISTA lettering on the leg. Black shorts with an orange drawstring at the July 2026 weigh-in.
kit.gloves: Black UFC gloves (blue cuffs in the blue corner).
kit.weigh_in_media: Grey or black tees at media; wristband at weigh-ins.

morphs_height_note: macro/heightDownM 0.07 from the research/assets.md male fit heightUpM = 2 * (H - 1.785 m) / 0.875 with H = 1.753 m; drop it if the avatar code scales to the tale of the tape directly. ageOldM = (33 - 25) / 65. eyebrows-angle-up/down are used here to mean the outer end of the brow goes up/down; flip if the target does the opposite. The deep nasolabial and cheek creases are better done in the normal map or a skin overlay than with shape morphs.

morphs_if_available.note: Ear targets are not in assets/embed/mh-manifest.json. If added: ears/l-ear-scale-incr and ears/r-ear-scale-incr about 0.15, ears/l-ear-rot-forward and ears/r-ear-rot-forward about 0.2; a mild thickened-helix normal map on both ears (right a bit more).

render_hints.skin_base: mh-skin-young_caucasian_male tinted toward #dd9a7c, body a step deeper (toward #c8875f); add forehead and nasolabial creases
render_hints.eyebrows: eyebrow001 tinted #1f1817, thick, low and straight
render_hints.hair: short04 or short02 with the sides shaved high and 5-7 cm on top swept back, tinted #221b1a

notes: Confidence: high for hair, brows, skin, physique and tattoos (clear studio photos and four July 2026 photos); medium-high for face proportions and profile (one sharp-ish profile at the weigh-in). No freely licensed photo exists on Commons, so every file is reference-only. Watch for: (1) long lean face with prominent cheekbones and deep nasolabial creases; (2) low, thick dark brows and an intense resting expression with slightly down-turned mouth corners; (3) high-shaved sides with a longer swept-back top; (4) the Death Before Dishonor chest script, ram skull on the right forearm, Battle/Born inner-forearm script and the colour jaguar-headdress piece on the right thigh; (5) lean but muscular 175 cm torso with broad deltoids; clean-shaven.
